description: This file is a shell script for testing various scenarios of 'git config' command behavior, including setting, getting, replacing, and unsetting configuration entries, as well as handling special characters and large numbers of entries.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a git configuration with a section and key.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies that a specific section.key has the expected value.

methods.name: check_regex
methods.description: Verifies that a section.key matches a regex and has the expected value.

methods.name: setup_many
methods.description: Sets up a large number of configuration entries for testing.
